column1: Hey, Sonny, you gotta see this! Dooley's really got his hands full! I don't know who this 'Gremlin' is but I sure am enjoying the grief he's causing Dooley.
column2: 嘿，Sonny，你一定要來看看！Dooley 真是忙得不可開交！我不知道這個「Gremlin」是誰，但他給 Dooley 找的麻煩真讓我開心。

column1: Oh, geez! I'm supposed to see Dooley PRONTO! He's gonna take a few pounds offa my hide if I don't get in there.
column2: 喔，天啊！我得馬上去見 Dooley！要是我不進去，他會狠狠教訓我一頓。

column1: Well, I hope he's got time to see you. He looks busier than a one-legged man at a butt-kicking contest. Damn, I crack myself up!
column2: 嗯，希望他有時間見你。他忙得像單腿的人參加踢屁股比賽。天啊，我真會逗自己笑！

column1: Sonny! Dooley wants to see you ASAP! He didn't look too happy either, buddy. It's been nice workin' with ya'. Ha ha!
column2: Sonny！Dooley 要你立刻去見他！夥計，他看起來也不太高興。跟你共事很愉快。哈哈！

column1: Sonny! Dooley was lookin' for you. He said he has something important to tell you. Maybe you've been promoted to Head Donut Fetcher! <snicker>
column2: Sonny！Dooley 正在找你。他說有重要的事要告訴你。也許你升官成為首席甜甜圈採買員了！<竊笑>

column1: And, Mr. Mayor, this is the rest of the downstairs area of our facility. As you can see, we keep a...
column2: 市長先生，這裡是我們設施一樓剩下的區域。如您所見，我們保存著……

column1: BONDS, WHERE THE HELL HAVE YOU... ah.. pardon me, Mr. Mayor.
column2: Bonds，你到底跑哪裡去了……啊……抱歉，市長先生。

column1: I'm currently conducting a tour of the department for the Mayor. But I'm gonna have a little chat with you...LATER.
column2: 我目前正在帶市長參觀警察局。不過我之後會和你談談……晚點再說。

column1: Get dressed and be in my office in 30 minutes. When I'm through with you, you're gonna need a PLUMBER to help you swallow your LUNCH!
column2: 穿好衣服，三十分鐘內到我辦公室。等我教訓完你，你得找水管工幫你把午餐吞下去！

column1: I'm sorry about this incident, Mr. Mayor. As I'm sure you're aware, no matter how fine a group of individuals we employ, there's always got to be one screw-up. We'll have one less in 30 minutes, I can assure you. Anyway, as I was saying...
column2: 市長先生，很抱歉發生這起事件。您一定知道，不管我們雇用的團隊多麼優秀，總會有一個害群之馬。我保證三十分鐘後就會少一個。總之，剛才說到……

column1: You don't want to interrupt Dooley and his new friend, do you? They make such a fun couple.
column2: 你不會想打斷 Dooley 和他的新朋友吧？他們真是有趣的一對。

column1: Only uniformed officers are allowed in the briefing room.
column2: 只有穿制服的警員可以進入簡報室。

column1: You remove your gunbelt. It carries your 9mm handgun, speedloader, and a pair of stainless steel handcuffs.
column2: 你解下槍帶。上面掛著 9mm 手槍、快速裝彈器和一副不鏽鋼手銬。

column1: Take your departmental issue piece with you on an undercover assignment, Bonds? Not too smart.
column2: Bonds，執行臥底任務還帶著配槍？不太明智。

column1: This is the handle for your locker. Once you've entered the combination, lifting this handle will open the locker.
column2: 這是置物櫃把手。輸入號碼後，抬起把手就能開櫃。

column1: Why don't you try your combination instead, Bonds?
column2: Bonds，何不試試你的號碼？

column1: Just as you start to enter your combination, you realize with panic that you've completely forgotten your locker combination. Damn! This happens every time!
column2: 你剛開始輸入號碼，就驚慌地發現自己完全忘了置物櫃密碼。該死！每次都這樣！

column1: Then you remember reading your combination somewhere recently...
column2: 接著你想起最近好像在哪裡讀過密碼……

column1: That's it! You saw it in the Gazette! Your combination is the same as the final score in the Grunters-Sows final playoff game.
column2: 沒錯！你在公報上看過！你的密碼就是 Grunters 對 Sows 季後賽決賽的最終比分。

column1: It's your locker door.
column2: 這是你的置物櫃門。

column1: You put your personal car keys in your locker.
column2: 你把私人車鑰匙放進置物櫃。

column1: You hang your gunbelt in the locker.
column2: 你把槍帶掛進置物櫃。

column1: You put the notebook and pen in the locker.
column2: 你把筆記本和筆放進置物櫃。

column1: You put the peroxide in the locker.
column2: 你把過氧化物放進置物櫃。

column1: You put your ticketbook in the locker.
column2: 你把開單簿放進置物櫃。

column1: These are lockers which give this room its name.
column2: 這些置物櫃就是這個房間名稱的由來。

column1: It's your ticket book and pen.
column2: 這是你的開單簿和筆。

column1: This is your departmental issue PR-24 nightstick.
column2: 這是警察局配發的 PR-24 警棍。

column1: The partition is good at keeping shower water away from the locker area.
column2: 隔板能有效防止淋浴水濺到置物櫃區。

column1: It's the bottle of peroxide you're supposed to use to dye your hair white. Pyew!
column2: 這瓶過氧化物是拿來把頭髮染白的。呸！
